subject: Antora Systems partnership — MSA/DPA redlines and SOW scope
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@antora.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Antora Legal <legal@antora.io>, Samir Gupta <samir@antora.io>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Antora + Redwood — MSA/DPA + draft SOW

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the kickoff call earlier. Per our discussion, attaching Antora's standard MSA (redlines v3), DPA comments, and a first-pass SOW for the connector work. High level: Antora will embed Redwood inference into Antora Edge for native prompt orchestration — expected pilot covers 3 ISV connectors and one customer proof-of-concept.

Asking for:
- Redwood's redline of the MSA/DPA (we flagged data residency + subprocessors)
- Confirmation on the SOW milestones and acceptance criteria
- Any procurement or security blockers (SOC2 / KMS / encryption at rest)

Attached: Antora_MSA_redline_v3.docx, Antora_DPA_comments.pdf, Draft_SOW_Antora_Integration.xlsx

Can we aim to exchange a counterproposal by EOD Monday (21 Jun)? If helpful, our legal (Samir) is available for a legal-to-legal call next week.

Best,
Elena
Business Lead, Strategic Alliances
Antora Systems

--
Attachment stubs: Antora_MSA_redline_v3.docx (docx), Antora_DPA_comments.pdf (pdf), Draft_SOW_Antora_Integration.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@antora.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 17:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Antora + Redwood — MSA/DPA + draft SOW

Elena, thanks — received and read through initial redlines. Appreciate the quick turnaround from your side.

Initial reaction / open questions (will coordinate legal review but want to surface business asks):
- Data flows: can you confirm the expected data types sent to Redwood (payload examples)? We need to map PII vs non-PII for DPA scoping.
- Subprocessors: Antora's list references a CDN + analytics vendor; we will need a current subprocessor list and SOC2 copies for any vendor handling token-level logs.
- Residency: Antora is asking to restrict EU customer traffic to eu-1 region. We can support region pinning, but need to confirm billing impact for dedicated routing.
- Acceptance: SOW's acceptance criteria look vague — propose adding explicit test plan (5 test cases + success thresholds) and a 14-day validation window post-delivery.
- Commercials: suggest we keep payment terms net 30, milestone-based invoicing; draft shows 60 days — prefer 30.
- Liability & indemnity: Antora's draft raises a full replacement cap; recommend negotiating to 12 months of fees or a $1M cap depending on deal size.

I'll pull in legal (Kimberly) for firm redlines and operations (Vanessa) for deployment constraints. Can we tentatively book legal-to-legal Wed 23 Jun if needed?

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:30:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: Antora MSA/DPA redlines — ask from Elena

Team — forwarding Antora's packet (see Drive link). High level ask: they want production support in 45 days for the pilot. Need recommendations on negotiation posture. Key areas to weigh in on:

1) Security & compliance
 - Require SOC2 Type II attestation from Antora and named subprocessors; where Antora refuses, ask for contractual controls + Right to audit narrow scope.
 - KMS: we should offer customer-managed keys for enterprise customers only; for pilot, Redwood managed keys ok with AES-256 at rest.
 - Logs/Retention: propose max 90 days for request/response logs, 13 months for customer metadata.

2) DPA / Data residency
 - Support eu-1 region pinning for EU customers; add clause that cross-border transfers require documented consent + SCCs.

3) Commercials / SOW
 - Acceptance: add 5 acceptance tests + 14-day remediation window.
 - Payment: insist net 30; milestone schedule aligned to deliverables M1 (integration), M2 (pilot), M3 (rollout).
 - Change orders: add PO-based change order path, capped at 20% of original SOW without renegotiation.

4) Liability & indemnity
 - Ask Legal to propose cap: greater of 12 months of SOW fees or $1M; carveouts for IP indemnity retained.

I suggest we produce a clean redline (Kenya) to send back with tracked comments. Kimberly — can you take the lead on MSA/DPA redlines (indemnity + data language)? Vanessa — ops can scope deployment constraints and quote for dedicated eu-1 routing. Karthik — flag procurement should we expect PO or enterprise SOW contract.

Target: consolidated counterproposal to Antora by EOD Mon 21 Jun.

Thanks,
Marcus

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Internal: Antora MSA/DPA redlines — ask from Elena

Marcus — quick notes from Legal after preliminary review of Antora_MSA_redline_v3.docx and DPA comments: 

- Indemnity cap: legal prefers 12 months of fees but will accept $1.5M floor for enterprise deals; propose we start 12 months / $1.5M whichever is higher.
- Data definitions: Antora left 'customer data' too broad. We will narrow definition and add example list (prompt text, user IDs, model responses) and exclude aggregated telemetry as necessary.
- Subprocessors: require 30-day notice + right to object within 15 days; agree to list name + role and SOC2 evidence.
- Security SLA: add a 99.9% uptime target for inference endpoints in SOW pilot with credits for degraded availability.
- Export controls: add standard export control compliance language — Antora asked about on-prem/air-gap; if they require on-prem, that's a different commercial path.

I'll prepare tracked redlines and an accompanying cover memo for commercial. Vanessa/Karthik please flag anything that materially affects deadlines/margins.

-Kimberly
Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@antora.io>
Cc: Antora Legal <legal@antora.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Antora — Consolidated counterproposal and next steps

Elena / Samir — thanks for the packet and patience while we reviewed. Attached are Redwood's consolidated responses: tracked redlines for the MSA, comments on the DPA, and a revised SOW with explicit milestones and acceptance tests. High-level changes included:

- Data & DPA: narrowed 'Customer Data' definition, added SCCs for transfers, and documented subprocessor notice + objection process.
- Security: we require SOC2 Type II evidence; for pilot we will accept Redwood-managed keys, with a KMS option in enterprise contracts.
- Residency: confirmed support for eu-1 region pinning for EU customers; routing/ops costs are noted in SOW (see M2 cost line).
- SOW: added 5 acceptance tests and a 14-day validation window; split milestones M1/M2/M3 with deliverable-based invoicing (net 30).
- Commercials: proposed liability cap = greater of 12 months of fees or $1.5M; payment terms net 30.

Next steps we propose:
1) Antora legal to review our tracked redlines (attached).
2) Allowed time: please provide comments by Fri 25 Jun so we can lock scope for the pilot week of 05 Jul.
3) If there are legal open points, let's set up a legal-to-legal call Wed 23 Jun 14:00 PT / 21:00 UTC — Kimberly will join.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_counter_redline.docx (tracked), Redwood_DPA_comments.pdf, Redwood_SOW_Antora_v2.xlsx

Happy to hop on a call to walk through major shifts.

Best,
Marcus
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
